Lower Text: [Your Turn][Once Per Turn] When this Digimon deletes an opponent's Digimon in battle, trash the top card of your opponent's security stack.
Upper Text: [When Digivolving] This Digimon gains ＜Piercing＞ for the turn. Then, if a Digimon card with [Angoramon] in its name is in this Digimon's digivolution cards, suspend 1 of your opponent’s Digimon.
